user.title: Govee H7140 BLE
user.description: Add a Govee H7140 Smart Humidifier Lite over Bluetooth. The device must be powered, in range and not connected to the Govee app.

data_description.address: The address shown by the Bluetooth integration. On macOS this is a CoreBluetooth UUID.
data_description.name: Friendly name for the humidifier.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Govee H7140 found
bluetooth_confirm.description: Do you want to add {name} ({model}) at {address}?

error.not_found: The device is not visible to Home Assistant's Bluetooth integration. Power it on, move it closer, or add it via Bluetooth discovery.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the humidifier.

abort.no_devices_found: No supported Govee H7140 was found.

init.title: Govee H7140 options
init.description: Polling, connection and experimental protocol options.

data_description.poll_interval: How often the humidifier is polled over GATT.
data_description.idle_disconnect: Keep the BLE link open for this long after the last operation. 0 disconnects immediately.
data_description.enable_adv_humidity: The H7140 advertisement contains a humidity byte; it is not exposed by Govee's cloud API.
data_description.enable_experimental: Required for the scene and Auto Stop switches. These frames are modelled and may need firmware-specific tuning.
data_description.enable_experimental_scenes: Adds Forest/Ocean/Wetland/Leisurely/Sleep effects to the night light.
data_description.enable_experimental_auto_stop: Adds an Auto Stop switch (0x17 selector).

send_frame.name: Send raw BLE frame
send_frame.description: Send a raw Govee frame to the humidifier for diagnostics or unsupported features.

frame.name: Frame
frame.description: Hex bytes, e.g. AA 05 00 or a complete 20-byte frame.

expect_response.name: Wait for response
expect_response.description: Return the first AA response within two seconds.
